{{Top|leg}}
An '''Inspection Clear chip''' was issued to [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that had passed a customs inspection for entry on to [[Algara II]], along with the successful completion of an [[Off-Worlder Visitation Intent data disk]]. A five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] filing fee was required.
